messages:
mira: quick sync re: NeoHealth pilot LOE. They asked for tenant isolation + per-tenant quotas in pilot. they want a locked pilot week.

alex: we need to decide: (A) expand MVP to include isolation+quotas (adds ~3w), or (B) keep MVP narrow and deliver isolation as v1.

tara: customer success POV: NeoHealth's compliance team will only run pilot if tenant isolation is demonstrable, but they said quota enforcement could be manual for first 2 weeks.

liam: engineering: isolation (namespaces + network policy) is ~1.5w infra + 1w app changes. quotas (token rate limiting per tenant) is another ~1w. end-to-end + e2e is +3d. combined ~3.5w.

priya: risks: shipping partial isolation is dangerous; if we promise isolation in pilot and it fails, they'll drop to v1 only. if we deferr and they refuse pilot, we lose momentum.

mira: two hybrid proposals: (1) Narrow MVP for pilot: deliver namespaces + visual proofs (dashboard + audit logs) but gate quota enforcement behind ops-assisted rules. (2) Full isolation+quotas in MVP but push pilot +3w.

alex: timeline calc: opt(1) -> pilot start in 2w, opt(2) -> pilot start in 5w. v1 GA shifts accordingly.

tara: can we do opt(1) with a staged acceptance? NeoHealth signs off on dashboard + manual quota enforcement for the pilot cohort, with a clause that automation must arrive by v1 GA. they seemed open to that in the call.

liam: ok technically: we can ship namespaces + read-only audit + a tagging workflow for quotas; ops runs a small enforcement script (2-3d per cohort). lower eng lift, but requires runbook.

priya: legal ask: we need the signed pilot annex documenting manual enforcement and rollback conditions. i'll draft and send to NeoHealth by EOD.

mira: decision: pick opt(1) — narrow MVP with ops-assisted quota enforcement; commit to quotas automated in v1. set milestone reset: pilot start +2w, v1 GA +7w.

alex: i'll update PRD and milestone board. add a launch gate: "Automation for quotas or documented manual workflow + runbook".

tara: i'll confirm wording with NeoHealth and get explicit acceptance for manual enforcement for pilot cohort. i'll also set their success metric: <24h seat provisioning and quota enforcement within business day.

liam: dev tasks: namespaces + audit dashboard (sprint), feature toggle for quota checks (off in pilot), infra RBAC audit. QA: staged rollout to single tenant before full cohort.

mira: actions:
• priya: pilot annex draft (EOD)
• alex: PRD + roadmap update (tomorrow)
• liam: spike for namespace rollout + runbook (48h)
• tara: confirm NeoHealth acceptance (today)
• calendar-bot: create milestone check-in Tuesday 11am

calendar-bot: "Event created: NeoHealth pilot scope check-in  Tuesday 11:00"

mira: marking thread resolved — we'll reopen if NeoHealth pushes for fully automated quotas before pilot start. :white_check_mark:
